# The Last Timeline

## Chapter One

It was **dark** in the citadel. Dr. Strange arrived at 3 p.m.
and found the [door](https://example.com) already open.

> Every timeline ends.

* * *

What he remembered afterwards:

- First, the council.
- Second, the war
  that followed.

## Chapter Two

Morning came, though no one could say from where.
